llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed SharePoint integration that uses ClawLink OAuth and gives broad SharePoint read/write capability, but the access matches its stated purpose and includes user-confirmation guidance for writes.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly for managing SharePoint and OneDrive resources via Microsoft Graph/SharePoint tools, including files, lists, permissions, sharing links, and deletes; this is broad but coherent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent to discover live tools, prefer reads before writes, preview unfamiliar or write actions, and require explicit user confirmation for creates, updates, deletes, and permission changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation requires adding the ClawLink plugin, allow-listing it in OpenClaw tools, and restarting the gateway; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned but changes the local agent tool environment.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a hosted ClawLink service and a connected Microsoft account, so it can access business SharePoint data within that account's permissions; this is expected for the integration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens and refresh are managed by ClawLink, and the tool allow-list setting persists after install; no hidden background worker, executable script, or unrelated persistence was present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust ClawLink with your Microsoft SharePoint connection. Before using write tools, verify the exact site, list, file, user, or permission target, because the skill can create, modify, share, delete, and change access to SharePoint content available to the connected account.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector.clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, and artifact review found only a markdown skill file with disclosed SharePoint/ClawLink instructions.
[StaticScan.clean] expected: The static scan reported no suspicious patterns; the inspected artifact contains no executable scripts and no obfuscated commands.
[VirusTotal.clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious detections, consistent with the single markdown artifact.
[CapabilityTags.requires-oauth-token.requires-sensitive-credentials] expected: OAuth and sensitive credential handling are expected because the skill connects a Microsoft account through ClawLink to access SharePoint resources.
